capabilities: process an inbox of captured tasks one decision at a time
surface next actions per project with sequential or parallel steps
track waiting-for items, defer/due dates and dependencies with emoji syntax
run weekly reviews with stalled-project detection and deadline warnings
forecast the week ahead and show a Gantt timeline
extras: Full manual and changelog live outside the README; pre-release versions installable via BRAT. README states the plugin makes no network requests and collects no data.
problem: Obsidian's checkbox tasks have no built-in structure for running the full Getting Things Done loop of capture, processing, next actions and weekly review.

relations.evidence: written in the Tasks plugin syntax, so both plugins share the same files

summary: GTD workflow plugin that adds inbox processing, next actions, defer dates, waiting-for tracking, forecasts and weekly review over plain Markdown tasks.
